standard-dialogue-varrock-library.player: HEY PETE, WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?

standard-dialogue-varrock-library.npc: Shhhh! It's a library you know!

Not much, just doing some research on Dwarvern Culture. Did you know that Keldagrim was originally constructed by a long lost clan who embraced the power of magic, and used it to aid with glorious buildings like
Yes. They even stayed down there for 1000 years or more, in a time they call 'The age of Kings'.
Shhhh! That's enough history for one day I think!

standard-dialogue-wilderness-bandit-camp.player: Pete, what are you doing out here in the deep wilderness?

standard-dialogue-wilderness-bandit-camp.npc: Shhh!! Don't let the others see me here! I'm on a top secret mission for the Burth..., no, nothing. Never mind. Oooo, look, the chaos elemental!! Quick, run!!

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.player: Hey Postie. Hows tricks? Who are you interviewing here?

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.npc: Everyone deserves a hic break you know. It gets pretty tiring lugging burp letters about all day.

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.player: I see. Can I join you?

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.npc: Why, am I hic coming apart?

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.player: You've been here a while, haven't you?

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.npc: Maybe I haves, maybe I haves. It all goes straight to my head you see.

standard-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.player: Yes... I can see that. Bye Pete!

standard-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.player: Hey Pete what you doing here?

standard-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.npc: Just doing a quick survey on famous people and their favourite colour. It's a special feature for 'West Wyverns Women's Weekly'.
Here! Are you mad? No, 'fraid I can't do that. Could cause all sorts of trouble.

standard-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.player: You're a bit mad really aren't you?

standard-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.npc: So would you be if you could speak over 1000 languages. I bet it's bliss being ignorant of this world's trouble! I'm off!

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.npc: Just chatting to my big brother Pete. Hee heee!!
Just a joke that he told me. Care to hear it?
2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.player: And so what did the other one say?

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.npc: Sigh. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.player: I see. So... what did the other one say?

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.npc: You're serious aren't you. Listen again. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'.

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.player: Fish, right. So, what was the reply?

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.npc: ARGH!! 2 PARROTS. ON A PERCH. SMELLS FISHY.

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.player: No, still lost. Is one of them a penguin?

standard-dialogue-falador-party-room.npc: You're doing it on purpose now aren't you? Please leave me alone!

standard-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.player: Hey Pete, what you doing here?

standard-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.npc: Just chatting to my brother Pete. He keeps Parrots.

standard-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.player: Doesn't sound too tough. What's the pay like?

standard-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.npc: Not very good I'm afraid. His bosses are pretty cheep.

standard-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.player: Groan. Don't give up the day job Pete.

standard-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.player: Hey Pete what you doing here?

standard-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.npc: Arrrr. Avast shipmate. Arrr. I Likes the cut of your gibb. Arrr. That it be.

standard-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.player: I have a strange feeling of Deja Vu. I must go now.

standard-dialogue-ice-mountain.player: Hey Postie! What you doing all the way up here?

standard-dialogue-ice-mountain.npc: I was just trying to get some wise words of wisdom from the Oracle. You know, she's been here a long, long time.

standard-dialogue-ice-mountain.player: Yes, I thought as much. What did she have to say?

standard-dialogue-ice-mountain.npc: First she said 'I am the Oracle, And when I open my lips, let no dog bark!'
I didn't know she was familiar with the works of Shakespeare. So I said 'Et tu, brute?'
Well, she started leaping about and pointing to Ardougne, shouting something about betrayal. She was really angry.

standard-dialogue-ice-mountain.player: Cripes! What do you think it means?

standard-dialogue-ice-mountain.npc: Who knows. Always cryptic to the last. See you around.

overhead-dialogue-varrock-library.npc: Reldo, have you found that book I was looking for yet?

overhead-dialogue-varrock-library.speaker: Reldo
overhead-dialogue-varrock-library.text: No, not yet... but I know I have seen it somewhere...

overhead-dialogue-varrock-library.npc: Sure, no problems. See you later.

overhead-dialogue-varrock-library.speaker: Reldo
overhead-dialogue-varrock-library.text: Bye! Say hi to the other Petes for me.

overhead-dialogue-wilderness-bandit-camp.npc: Psssst! How is the plan going?
Great. Now don't forget - nobody does anything until I give the word! OK?

overhead-dialogue-wilderness-bandit-camp.speaker: Noterazzo
overhead-dialogue-wilderness-bandit-camp.text: Sure no problem. We'll be waiting.

overhead-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.speaker: Barmaid
overhead-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.text: 4 Pints coming right up. Are you expecting guests?

overhead-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.speaker: Barmaid
overhead-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.text: You want me to put it on your tab?

overhead-dialogue-laughing-miner-pub.npc: That would be great, thanks. Oh cripes! I've left a fire burning! I'll be back in a mo.

overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.speaker: Lanthus
overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.text: Easy Pete, calm down. Don't lose your head!

overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.npc: Cheeky!! If you're not careful I'll get you cursed too!

overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.speaker: Lanthus
overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.text: You wouldn't catch me double-crossing a witch!

overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.npc: But which witch is which! Anyway, I'm late for an appointment with the oracle.

overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.speaker: Lanthus
overhead-dialogue-castle-wars-lobby.text: Take care and say hi to the kids for me.

overhead-dialogue-falador-party-room.npc: Hey, bro! How's the party business?
Nice. Well, I'm here to talk to some White Knights.

overhead-dialogue-falador-party-room.speaker: Party Pete
overhead-dialogue-falador-party-room.text: Want to take some cake with you?

overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.npc: Mum wants to know if you're coming round for tea.

overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.speaker: Parroty Pete
overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.text: No, I've got another late night here.

overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.speaker: Parroty  Pete
overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.text: Ol' bluebeak's got the flu again!

overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.npc: Oh dear. Nothing too serious I hope.

overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.speaker: Parroty  Pete
overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.text: Well, as long as he hasn't caught anything from that evil chicken.

overhead-dialogue-ardougne-zoo.npc: Got a taste for parrots now too has he?
Sigh.* Will nothing sacred be safe?

overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.npc: Hey Pete. Any news from the fleet?

overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.speaker: Pirate Pete
overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.text: 'Tis all quiet on the eastern front.

overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.npc: Well, you know what to do if something goes wrong.

overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.speaker: Pirate Pete
overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.text: Holler like a bosun without a bottle.

overhead-dialogue-north-of-port-phasmaty.npc: That's it brother, and we'll come a running!

overhead-dialogue-ice-mountain.npc: Well, I'm back. And he said no. Again.
Lemons? What are you talking about?
I swear you get stranger every time.

overhead-dialogue-upon-changing-location.npc: Now, how's this thing work again...?
